title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Confirms Release Date With New Trailer – Watch
content: Dragon Ball Super is coming back this Fall with a brand new remake anime series , and Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has set a release date with a new trailer and poster showing it all off.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus New Trailer Previews Opening and Ending Themes, October 11 Premiere
content: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus anime revealed its theme songs in the new “SUPER SURGE” trailer, along with an October 11 premiere date. The series was previously confirmed to release Fall 2026, slowly leading up to the upcoming Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol (Moro Arc) anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: Atsu Benino's Hōkago Voca-Ken de! Manga Ends
content: This year's 40th issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine announced on Wednesday that Atsu Benino 's Hōkago Voca-Ken de! (Afterschool at the Vocaloid Research Club) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on September 9.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku Film Reveals Theme Song Artist, Trailer, Poster
content: The official website for the live-action film of Ryō Nakama 's High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku ( Kōkōsei Kazoku ) manga announced the theme song artist in a new trailer on Wednesday. The trailer previews the theme song "Kore mo Seishun da" (This is Also Youth) by Yuzu.
author: ANN

title: One Piece’s Elbaph Arc Is Ignoring the Character With the Most Potential, And It’s a Shame
content: One Piece manga is currently depicting the Elbaph arc, which even the anime has caught up with. However, the manga is now deep into the arc, featuring an epic battle against what many believe to be the final villain of the series.
author: ComicBook

title: Ninja vs. Gokudo Author Apologizes for Hiatus, Citing Mental Health
content: Manga creator Shinsuke Kondō posted on his X/Twitter account on Tuesday an apology that his Ninja vs. Gokudo manga is still on hiatus after half a year (the manga's 146th and latest chapter debuted on March 23), and explained that he is still grappling with mental health issues.
author: ANN

title: Major Shonen Jump Hit Gets New U.S. Release Schedule & Raises Its Chances of Getting an Anime
content: A major series from Shueisha’s library of Shonen Jump magazines is getting a newly updated release schedule in the United States, and with it has really raised its chances of getting an anime in the near future.
author: ComicBook

title: Pokémon Films Get BD Collection in November
content: Viz Media announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Tuesday that it will release a 16-disc limited edition Blu-ray collection of all 24 Pokémon movies released so far on Amazon exclusively on November 24. The disc collection comes with a special Pokéball-shaped container.
author: ANN

title: My Hero Academia: All's Justice Game Adds DLC Character Izuku Midoriya Overlay Full Style
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment announced on Wednesday that its My Hero Academia : All's Justice game will add DLC character Izuku Midoriya Overlay Full Style to the game on Thursday. The character is available as part of the season pass.
author: ANN

title: Bungo Stray Dogs Returns With Special Crunchyroll Trailer While Fans Wait on Season 6
content: Bungo Stray Dogs has kicked off a celebration for a major milestone, and Crunchyroll is going all out for the occasion with a special trailer showing off how far the anime has come over the last decade.
author: ComicBook
